Geometry Dash F-Droid Repo

Fan-made F-Droid repository with Geometry Dash games. Includes all of the Geometry Dash spin-offs and Boomlings games.

Currently it serves 8 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://vladplaygh2.github.io/gd-fdroid/fdroid/repo
